subject: AP vendor enrollment, PO formatting, and EORI/VAT follow-up
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@arinka.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: t.kowalski@arinka.com, ap@arinka.com
Date: 2028-09-14T09:22:00+02:00
Subject: Vendor enrollment / initial PO & tax questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — Arinka is excited to proceed. Our AP team asked me to gather the following so we can create Redwood as a vendor in our system and make sure the first invoices flow smoothly:

- Legal name and registered address to appear on invoices
- VAT / EORI or US tax form (we operate EU/UK/US)
- Preferred invoice format (PDF only, or PDF + XML/CSV for automated ingestion)
- PO number format (do you require a PO on each invoice and do Po numbers follow a specific prefix?)
- Bank details and remittance instructions (for wire and SEPA)

Could you send a short AP onboarding packet we can attach to the vendor record? Also — we sometimes require a vendor sample invoice mapped to our PO line items and GL codes. I can share Arinka's PO template for mapping if helpful.

If we can get the vendor record created this week, finance can approve the initial net-60 term for our pilot.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement Operations
Arinka S.p.A.

Attachments: (none in original)
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@arinka.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-09-15T10:08:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment / initial PO & tax questions

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. Attached is a draft AP onboarding packet that includes: our legal entity, registered address, VAT/EORI notes, bank wiring + SEPA details, invoice requirements, and a short remittance advice template. Quick notes inline below and in the attachment:

- Legal name for your system: Redwood Inference, Inc. (we have multiple legal entities depending on region — the attached packet marks the EU billing entity as Redwood Inference EU SRL)
- VAT/EORI: we are VAT-registered in the EU; scanned EORI cert is attached in my next message (we keep a single EU VAT number for the EU billing entity)
- Invoice format: we can produce PDF invoices and include a machine-readable CSV export on request. For automated ingestion we recommend PDF+CSV.
- PO: Please place your PO number in the invoice header and in the invoice file name. Our team prefers the PO in the field labeled "Customer PO"; we can accept any prefix provided it is present on each invoice. Example: ARK-2028-000123
- Payment terms: standard is Net 30 on hosted accounts, but we can accept and document Net 60 for the pilot as agreed. Ben (cc) will confirm the final commercial term for this engagement.

Next steps:
1) I attached a Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_KP-draft.pdf for your AP team to review.
2) Please return Arinka_PO_Template.xlsx with a sample PO populated so we can map line items to GL codes.
3) Send the EORI/VAT docs for Arinka so we can attach them to our vendor record as well.

If it helps, we can do a 20-minute screenshare to walk through the packet and mapping.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_KP-draft.pdf (PDF, 4 pages)
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@arinka.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: t.kowalski@arinka.com, ap@arinka.com
Date: 2028-09-16T08:37:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment / initial PO & tax questions

Kimberly —

Thanks, packet looks good. I've attached our PO template (Arinka_PO_Template.xlsx) and our EORI certificate. A few clarifications from AP after an initial pass:

- AP needs invoices to include: Customer PO, PO line number (if invoice references multiple PO lines), invoice total in EUR, GL mapping column on the sample invoice so we can validate automated allocation.
- They prefer PDF+CSV. The CSV should include: invoice_number, invoice_date, line_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, currency, po_number, gl_code.
- For bank details: we see the SEPA IBAN in the packet. Can you confirm the beneficiary name exactly as it should appear on our vendor record? The AP team is picky about exact matches (accidental spacing or punctuation can block ACH/SEPA).
- DocuSign: procurement asked for a confirmation of commercial terms to be signed — I can send a DocuSign envelope if you provide the final customer-facing billing entity and the payment term (we'll mark Net 60 for the pilot).

Attached: Arinka_PO_Template.xlsx, EORI_Certificate_Arinka.pdf

We'll populate a draft vendor record after you confirm the beneficiary name and sign the DocuSign.

Regards,
Elena

Attachments: Arinka_PO_Template.xlsx (Excel), EORI_Certificate_Arinka.pdf (PDF)
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@arinka.com>, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-09-17T14:26:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment / initial PO & tax questions

Elena — quick follow-up from finance side.

Thanks for the template and the EORI. A couple questions before we sign:

- Beneficiary name: please use exactly "Redwood Inference EU SRL" for the EU billing/journal entries. That is the entity that will issue invoices to Arinka EU.
- Remittance: attached is our Redwood_Remittance_Advice_Template.xlsx — please map the Arinka sample PO to that format so our collections team can reconcile payments automatically.
- Terms: We can accept Net 60 for the pilot. For longer-term engagements our standard is Net 30; we can document exceptions in the DocuSign SOW addendum.
- Vendor ID creation: once you return the populated PO template and sign the DocuSign confirmation of commercial terms, I will create the vendor in our AP system and send you the vendor ID and any invoice routing rules (email webhook for automated ingestion if you choose PDF+CSV).

If you prefer, Marissa (cc) and I can join the DocuSign review call.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

- Arinka will send the first PO (ARK-2028-000201) to the vendor record; Redwood to issue the first invoice referencing that PO.
